deliberateActions.label: Choose the project and preview adoption
Run Doctor and accept the diagnosed surface
Create or accept the first Script Class
Build, Restart and Continue for first native setup
Place the Actor or attach the Component
Press Play and inspect the running Script Class

scenarios.rationale: The initial budget includes one explained native-build restart and treats the existing packaged acceptance duration as a conservative enclosing upper bound.

deliberateActions.label: Edit and save one compatible C# or Graph change
Review and accept the semantic Diff
Build and Reload the accepted change

scenarios.rationale: A body-compatible daily edit may rebuild managed gameplay and its compiled chunk only; native/schema invalidation or an Editor restart is a regression for this scenario.

revisionNotes: v0.1 freezes the M13.2 action vocabulary and separates the enclosing first-Play run from the exact daily reload receipt.
Automation evidence is hash-bound and must prove the all-instance reload preflight plus preserved demo state.
